attributes.rationale: Teacher uploads metadata, a reference solution, and test inputs; expected-output generation completes asynchronously.
An authenticated request becomes a PENDING execution, stored source artifact, and queue job; the API returns 202 for polling.
Worker reports update persisted execution summary; detailed report artifacts are retrieved from MinIO.
Test changes are staged, validated asynchronously, then atomically promoted while stale worker results are rejected.
A group has one CREATE_GROUP-authorized owner, enrollment history, and assignments.
Student-only enrollment preserves history through ACTIVE, LEFT, and REMOVED states and reactivates on rejoin.
Archived groups are read-only; logical deletion archives and hides them from students; restoration remains archived.
Student visibility requires active assignment and group, READY validation, and reached launch date.
Authenticated enrolled students may submit until closeDate; each immutable submission retains its durable late flag.
Feedback and grades belong to the assignment-student relationship; grading history is retained when grades are cleared.
Cloning copies metadata and input assets to another owned active group, then regenerates expected outputs asynchronously.
Durable Jackson-converted RabbitMQ queues connect backend, worker, and in-process notification delivery.
All JPA entity identifiers use UUID generation; DTOs and API paths use UUID values rather than Long.
Reference solutions and test suites are immutable revisions selected by Assignment; AssignmentUpdate stages validation.
Global settings plus sparse per-type overrides determine email delivery; dispatch logs only deduplicate scheduled work.
Shared status enum includes AC, WA, CE, RTE, TLE, MLE, OLE, and PENDING.
Every notification type belongs exclusively to TEACHER or STUDENT and has default enabled behavior.
Inactive users, a disabled global switch, or disabled type override prevent sending; preferences are checked at dispatch and consumption.
A ten-minute scheduler discovers publication/reminder work and records deterministic keys, while RabbitMQ owns pending messages.
Unsupported schemas go to DLQ; delivery failures retry after five minutes up to five attempts with at-least-once semantics.
Successful domain transactions publish events that are routed after commit to resolve recipients and dispatch email work.
Versioned RabbitMQ message contract for pending academic email delivery.
Exactly one strategy must implement each catalog type; duplicate or missing claims fail startup.
Authenticated routes retrieve, update, reset, and test a principal's notification settings without accepting a user ID.
The consumer validates schema and recipient preferences, chooses a strategy, renders MIME alternatives, then sends or retries/DLQs.
Welcome and password-recovery mail use branded templates and SMTP synchronously outside the academic notification queue.
Assignment rescheduling and feedback notification workflows are specified for activation as their owning business features mature.
NotificationDomainEventRouter uses AFTER_COMMIT and a new read transaction so failed business transactions cannot publish notifications.
A unique deduplication key prevents scheduler rediscovery from creating duplicate publication/reminder work; it stores no message payload or attempt state.
Thymeleaf renders English HTML and plaintext alternatives with frontend and preferences links.
Each request validates bearer-token signature and expiration, loads current user details, rejects disabled users, and populates SecurityContext.
Authorization derives authorities from current Role and Scope; SUPER_ADMIN expands to every scope at authentication time.
Controllers consume Authentication from SecurityContext rather than reparsing Authorization headers.
Services upload and download MinIO artifacts by deterministic ObjectKeyBuilder keys.
The frontend provides routing, shared state, API access, and guarded user interfaces for authentication and current administration flows.
Dashboard, create-user, and CSV-upload pages are wrapped in ThemeProvider and ADMIN ProtectedRoute guards.
CSV upload returns a backend task ID and consumes WebSocket progress with lifecycle cleanup.
The guard checks locally stored token then /api/auth/me, validates optional roles/scopes, and redirects unauthorized users.
Dedicated professor routes, modules, and services are not implemented yet.
app/routes.ts maps public home/login/recovery routes and currently protected admin routes to thin route modules.
Centralizes auth API calls, localStorage token management, Bearer headers, and the CSV-progress WebSocket URL.
Dedicated student routes, modules, and service logic are not implemented yet.
Background Spring Boot service consumes RabbitMQ jobs, runs untrusted code in isolated Docker environments, compares outputs, stores artifacts, and returns reports.
EXACT_MATCH compares normalized lines; FLOATING_POINT compares tokens with 1e-9 numeric tolerance and detailed deterministic feedback.
Compile-checks executions, runs test cases in practice or definitive modes, aggregates verdicts, uploads artifacts, and publishes a report.
Compile-checks reference code and generates each expected output artifact; reference-only updates compare candidate output with active output.
Both worker pipelines abort their main execution loop on CE, while result publication remains mandatory.
Consumes opaque-path ExecutionJob entries and publishes an RTE fallback report if unexpected execution failure occurs.
Consumes TestGenerationJob and publishes a failed result on unhandled errors, preserving correlation IDs for stale-result rejection.
Common language executor contract caps source/input sizes and returns status, output, timing, memory, exit, and compilation information.
All compile and run containers disable networking, cap CPU/memory/PIDs/file size, drop capabilities, use read-only roots, nobody user, no-new-privileges, and seccomp.
A shared 4 MB stdout/stderr cap returns OLE; compilation stderr has a separate 256 KB cap.
Spring components keyed by Language enum choose JAVA, PYTHON, C, or CPP executor; unknown language is rejected.
